I couldn't set up the daily digest. Scheduled jobs in this environment run locally and their output doesn't reach Slack DMs, so a 09:00 message would never arrive. I haven't scheduled anything.

I've replied in your DM with the alternative: ask me here and I'll read #coastal-team (you're a member) and post a summary. Money terms would be left out of the summary, or sent only to Anselm, June or the account owner.
